title: Instrumenting Failure: Scoring Language Model Agents at Every Decision Node in Imperfect-Information Games
abstract: arXiv:2611.20644v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent evaluations report task success and rarely say what an agent did at each decision. We score every decision node of three 12B to 14B instruct-tuned language models (LMs) playing five zero-sum imperfect-information games against four opponents on eight properties from decision and game theory, five of them against a CFR+ equilibrium reference. At each node, the LM also states a belief about the opponent's hidden state in a separate call. Without memory and at temperature 0, stated beliefs sit 0.250 to 0.288 in total variation distance from the equilibrium posterior, and where the action responds to the state its agreement with that belief exceeds chance by -0.04 to 0.19. The two calls frame the opponent differently, so the result is a behavioural inconsistency and makes no claim about internal beliefs. Under one prompt and greedy decoding, the LM's action never varies with the state in 10 of the 38 cells where the reference varies

translated_title: 《对失败的精细测量：在不完美信息博弈中对语言模型智能体的每个决策节点进行评分》
translated_abstract: 智能体评估通常只报告任务成败，很少说明智能体在每个决策点上究竟做了什么。我们使用决策论与博弈论中的八项属性，对三个参数量为12B至14B的指令微调语言模型（LM）在与四个对手进行的五种零和不完美信息博弈中的每个决策节点进行评分，其中五项属性以CFR+均衡作为参照基准。在每个节点上，语言模型还会在单独的调用中陈述其对对手隐藏状态的信念推断。在没有记忆且温度为0的条件下，所陈述的信念与均衡后验分布的总变异距离为0.250至0.288；而在动作应对状态作出响应的情形中，动作与该信念的一致性超出随机水平-0.04至0.19。由于两次调用以不同方式框定对手，所得结果反映的是一种行为不一致性，并不能对内部信念作出断言。在单一提示词与贪婪解码下，在参照策略会随状态变化的38个实验单元中，有10个单元里语言模型的动作从不随状态而变化。
tldr: 本文提出一种在不完美信息博弈中对语言模型智能体每个决策节点进行细粒度评分的评估方法，通过行为性质、信念准确度和信念-动作一致性等维度，揭示了模型陈述信念与均衡后验显著偏离、且在贪婪解码下部分局面中动作不随状态变化的行为不一致问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a fine-grained evaluation framework that scores language model agents at every decision node in imperfect-information games, revealing that stated beliefs deviate substantially from equilibrium posteriors and that actions often fail to vary with the hidden state under greedy decoding, exposing behavioral inconsistencies.
